parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated sort rules in field:order format, e.g. status:asc,createdAt:desc

parameters.name: testEmail
parameters.description: Only honored by the "fake" provider (dev/test); seeds the mock identity email.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text match against action, entity type, and request ID.

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Template variables encoded as a JSON object string, e.g. {"displayName":"Jane"}.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Match against the original file name.

sendable.description: Whether this template can be sent ad hoc via POST /admin/mail/send.

missingVariables.description: Template variables with no supplied or default value.

templateKey.description: Non-mandatory template key (security templates cannot be sent ad hoc).

idempotencyKey.description: Replaying the same key returns the original job instead of sending again.
Replaying the same key returns the original result instead of re-running the batch.

scheduledAt.description: ISO-8601 datetime. Omit or set to now for immediate delivery.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key. Retries with the same key return the original notification job.
